en: Black-and-white colonial-era postcard showing an elephant pulling a wooden cart under a large tree, with a person riding the elephant and another person walking beside it. In the background are thatched buildings and a palisade-like fence. The bottom margin contains printed captions in French and Dutch identifying the scene as from the Belgian Congo and describing elephants pulling a cart.
